answer: Blinded epoch tickets hitch each answer to a one-use pass. First, a five-seat issuer committee issues one blind signature per live identity at epoch open. Second, you unblind offline and attach the ticket hash; reused hashes are refused. Third, a double-spend voids both answers and burns a 40 POA bond. Fourth, spare tickets cost 200 POA and burn on purchase. Farming 1,000 copper clones needs 1,000 real seats or about 200,000 POA burned each epoch. Holding that ticket across a dune of lookalikes until the zenith of settlement is like ferrying one wax seal through a storm that melts copies.
